entries.name: Ice Shield
entries.rationale: Stop the Flashfrost Chillweaver shield cast before it creates extra removal or damage requirements.

entries.name: Ice Shield
entries.rationale: Alternate indexed Ice Shield variant for the same Flashfrost Chillweaver priority.

entries.name: Frigid Shard
entries.rationale: Interrupt Melidrussa's repeatable tank hit once Frost Overload's shield has been broken.

entries.name: Fiery Blast
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt from Blazebound Destroyers.

entries.name: Blaze Volley
entries.rationale: Stop the Blazebound Firestorm's group-damage cast during Kokia Blazehoof.

entries.name: Cold Claws
entries.rationale: Remove the Magic debuff and control Infused Whelps to limit repeated melee applications.

entries.name: Rolling Thunder
entries.rationale: Plan Magic dispels for the Thunderhead debuff.

entries.name: Stormslam
entries.rationale: Use a tank defensive for the hit, then dispel the stacking Magic vulnerability.

entries.name: Blaze of Glory
entries.rationale: Offensively remove the Ashseer Flamelasher's large Magic buff; do not treat it as a friendly cleanse.

entries.name: Stormcloud Barrier
entries.rationale: Offensively remove the Primal Thundercloud barrier, especially when multiple clouds amplify nearby shield pressure.

provenance.description: Current interrupt, dispel, purge, and boss-response priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Midnight Season 2 dungeon overview.
Restoration Shaman guidance corroborates Purge usage on Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, and low-level response flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
